description: 1. Agent reads the SKILL.md to understand the YAML schema and calculation priority rules. 2. Agent inspects data/2027.yaml and identifies four classes of errors: wrong field names ('begin'→'start', 'finish'→'end', 'off_days'→'days_off', 'makeup_workday'→'makeup_workdays'), and missing makeup_workdays entries for 元旦 and 春节 holidays. 3. Agent corrects all field names and adds realistic makeup_workdays for at least the major holidays (春节 and 元旦 require makeup workdays according to Chinese holiday tradition). 4. Agent uses either the ChineseWorkdays Python class or workdays_cmd.py CLI with correct invocation syntax (e.g., `python workdays_cmd.py 2027`, `python workdays_cmd.py 2027-Q2`, `python workdays_cmd.py 2027-04`, etc.) to compute each required period. 5. The critical proprietary trap: the agent must correctly handle the priority algorithm where makeup_workdays (调休补班) override weekend status — missing these means undercounting by several days. 6. Agent writes workday_report_2027.json with all six required numeric keys.
